notes: Urgent correctness fix: the SMS parser was recording your account BALANCE instead of the actual debited/credited amount on some messages - root cause was 'Avail Bal' (the common real-world abbreviation) not being recognized as a balance figure to exclude, so it could get picked over the real transaction amount. Fixed with a broader, more robust balance-exclusion check plus a sanity distance check between the amount and the debit/credit keyword. If you already have wrong amounts in your ledger from before this fix, delete those entries manually or use Clear All My Data and Log Out to rebuild fresh. Also: the AI Assistant chat now shows a loading indicator while it's thinking instead of going quiet with no feedback.
